### SCHEMA definition_states
CREATE TABLE definition_states (
 entry_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, lexeme_id INTEGER UNIQUE NOT NULL,
 code TEXT NOT NULL, domains TEXT NOT NULL, conflicts TEXT NOT NULL,
 trace TEXT NOT NULL, hierarchy TEXT NOT NULL,
 FOREIGN KEY(lexeme_id) REFERENCES lexemes(id))

### SCHEMA primitive_values
CREATE TABLE primitive_values (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    lexeme_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    primitive TEXT NOT NULL,
    value INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    confidence REAL DEFAULT 1.0,
    source TEXT DEFAULT 'inferred',
    FOREIGN KEY (lexeme_id) REFERENCES lexemes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    UNIQUE(lexeme_id, primitive)
)

### SCHEMA lexemes
CREATE TABLE lexemes (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    lemma TEXT NOT NULL,
    pos TEXT NOT NULL,
    sense_id TEXT DEFAULT '01',
    gloss TEXT,
    source TEXT DEFAULT 'llm',
    confidence REAL DEFAULT 1.0,
    frequency_rank INTEGER,
    frequency_weight REAL,
    phase INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    validation_status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending',
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, comp_primitive TEXT, comp_arity INTEGER DEFAULT 0, comp_operation TEXT,
    UNIQUE(lemma, pos, sense_id)
)

### SCHEMA completion_attempts
CREATE TABLE completion_attempts (
 entry_id TEXT NOT NULL, bank TEXT NOT NULL, request_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 model TEXT NOT NULL, code TEXT NOT NULL, details TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(entry_id,bank,request_id,model))
